label: eq:d001
what: Restates $S_d(D)=A_{u_d}(D)$ of eq:normgroup, with $u_d=(4d)^5$; covered by that display's test.

label: eq:d002
what: Brute-force point count = minus Legendre sum = PARI ellap for 1065 pairs $(d,p)$, $p<600$; sign falsifier fails.

label: eq:d003
what: Sympy: shifting $1-a_pp^{-s}+p^{1-2s}$ by $1/2$ gives $1-\lambda_d(p)p^{-s}+p^{-2s}$; the unshifted variant fails.

label: eq:qd
what: Reciprocal Euler factor has coefficients $1,-\lambda,1,0,\dots$ (sympy); the full series is matched coefficientwise with PARI in A2.07.

label: eq:integer-convolution
what: 32382 values ($m\le2\cdot10^4$, 5 values of $d$) against the multiplicative $q_d$; dropping $(r,t)=1$ or $\mu(t)^2$ fails.

label: eq:d004
what: Definition; the tests build $B_d$ from minimal-model local factors at $p\mid6d$ (PARI), e.g. $B_{16}(3)=1/(1+2^{-6})$.

label: eq:reciprocal
what: $L(E_d,s+\frac12)\sum q_dm^{-s}=B_d$ coefficientwise, exact vs PARI ellan, 10 values of $d$ (some non-minimal), $m\le6000$; also numerically (T1-E1).

label: eq:target
what: Definition of $S_d(D)$; evaluated in A2.09, A3.08 and in T1-M2 (direct quadrature of $F_W$).

label: eq:d005
what: Same formula as the zeta guide [ZG, (1.2)]; A0.08: $c$ inverts $\zeta(s)L(s,\chi_{-3})$ for $m\le2\cdot10^4$; A2.10: the case formula.

label: eq:d006
what: All four columns for 2566 pairs $(d,p)$, $p<3000$, including $a_p=0$ at inert $p$ (PARI); the variant $q_d(p^2)=-1$ fails.

label: eq:d007
what: $|A+B\omega|^2=A^2-AB+B^2$ on $|A|,|B|\le60$; the variant $A^2+AB+B^2$ fails; $\alpha$ is notation.

label: eq:d008
what: Every $n$ coprime to 3 with $|A|,|B|\le40$ has exactly one associate with $A\equiv1$, $B\equiv0$ mod 3, and it is $\equiv1$ mod 3.

label: eq:d009
what: Exact: $\mu_K(-5)=-1$; $7=(1+3\omega)(-2-3\omega)$, both factors primary of norm 7, so $\mu_K(7)=1$.

label: eq:Au
what: Definition; implemented literally (matrix of sextic symbols times columns) in A4.02, A4.04, A5.05.

label: eq:ud
what: $\chi_n((4d)^5)=\overline{\chi_n(4d)}$ via symbol indices for 12000 pairs, zeros kept; rows $4d$ and $d^5$ fail (also in the additional Python/PARI check deuring_identity/hecke_identity.py).

label: eq:d010
what: Index arithmetic: index of $(4d)^5$ is $5\cdot$index of $4d$, i.e. minus it mod 6, zeros preserved, 12000 pairs $(d,n)$.

label: eq:point-identity
what: Exact in $\mathbb Z[\omega]$ for 27528 pairs $(d,\pi)$, $|d|\le60$, $p<1500$; unconjugated, $\chi_\pi(d)$ and $-\pi$ variants fail.

label: eq:d011
what: $\psi_d(\pi)\psi_d(\bar\pi)=1$ and $\psi_d(\pi)+\psi_d(\bar\pi)=\lambda_d(p)$ for $p<3000$, 5 values of $d$; the unconjugated variant fails.

label: eq:normgroup
what: Exact in $\mathbb Z[\omega]$, 8 values of $d$, $m\le2\cdot10^4$; $S_d=A_{u_d}$ to 1.3e-14; an additional Python/PARI check of 10800 pairs $(d,n)$ (deuring_identity/hecke_identity.py; a numerical check, not a Lean proof); rows $4d$, $d^5$ fail.

label: eq:d012
what: First identity exact vs PARI ellan for 51264 coefficients ($m\le2\cdot10^4$, 8 values of $d$); the second is eq:normgroup.

label: eq:d013
what: Notation; checked that $\chi^2$ is the cubic symbol, $\chi^3$ the Legendre symbol and $\kappa(-1)=1$, 188 pairs $(p,\pi)$, $p<1200$.

label: eq:d014
what: Both root counts exact at every residue, 188 pairs $(p,\pi)$, $7\le p<1200$; the variants $1+\rho(V)$ and $\chi$ for $\kappa$ fail.

label: eq:b1-count
what: Character expansion equals the brute-force affine count, both equalities exact in $\mathbb Z[\omega]$, 4412 pairs $(d,\pi)$, $p<400$.

label: eq:d015
what: $S=\rho(d)\kappa(d)J(\kappa,\rho)$ exact in $\mathbb Z[\omega]$ for 4412 pairs $(d,\pi)$, $0<|d|\le30$, $p<400$.

label: eq:d016
what: All three equalities and the root count $1+\rho(1-4a)$, exact, 188 pairs $(p,\pi)$; the $1-2a$ and unconjugated $\kappa(4)$ variants fail.

label: eq:b1-S
what: $S=-\rho(d)\kappa(4d)\pi$ and brute-force $a_p=\mathrm{Tr}(\rho(d)\kappa(4d)\pi)$ exact, 11252 triples $(p,\pi,d)$; sign and $\kappa(d)$ variants fail.

label: eq:b1-euler
what: All five members evaluated (last by PARI lfun) at $s=3$, $2.5+4i$ for 7 values of $d$; four wrong variants fail.
script: displays_2026-10-13/t1/t1_euler_chain.py T1-E1; part_A_lines_0001_0549/t2_integer.py A2.07; t3_lattice.py A3.08

label: eq:M
what: Definition; computed literally (all rows, all columns) in A4.02, A4.07 and A5.09.

label: eq:coordinates
what: Literal four-coordinate evaluation equals the double-sum form at three $(D,H)$; coordinate columns = primary columns coprime to 6.

label: eq:double
what: Expanded double sum with $S_H$ equals the coordinate form; unconjugated $\alpha(n_1)$ and $\chi_{n_1}$ variants fail.

label: eq:d017
what: $A_u(D)=\sum_mq_u(m)W(m/D)$ for 5 rows, $D\le3000$; dropping $\mu_K$ fails ($q_u$ itself is a definition).

label: eq:allrows
what: Exact in $\mathbb Z[\omega]$: 30 rows, local table, multiplicativity, vanishing at 2, 3 and $p^j$, $j\ge3$, reduction to eq:qd.

label: eq:MS
what: Size check: $M(D,D^{1.1})/D^{2.1}$ between 0.27 and 0.29 for $D\le1600$; proved by Prop. b2-reduction and Sections 7-10.

label: eq:d018
what: $S_H(n,n)$ equals the number of coprime rows for 150 columns, $H=2\cdot10^4$, and is at most the row count.

label: eq:d019
what: Size check of the error term over 62 columns, $H\le4\cdot10^5$; identical to [ZG, (4.2)]; elementary lattice counting.

label: eq:d020
what: 3000 random $(d,n,v)$: $\chi_n(u_dv^6)=\chi_n(u_d)$ if $(n,v)=1$, else 0; the $v^2$ variant fails.

label: eq:d021
what: Definition; implemented in A5.03-A5.04 and r1; no admissible prime of norm below 7, two of norm 7.

label: eq:d022
what: Difference of the rows equals the sum over $\pi\mid n$, $D=3000$, $Y=60$, $d=1,7$; the sum over $\pi\nmid n$ fails.

label: eq:approx
what: Explicit form $(1+16b)\|W\|_\infty D/Y$ of Lemma b1-extract(iii) checked in 216 cases; proved there.
result: size check: ratio to explicit bound $\le0.022$

label: eq:extraction
what: Toy instances with the actual $M(D,H)$, $H$ up to $10^6$: the proof chain holds, dropping the error term fails; Lemma b1-extract(iv).
result: size check: explicit chain holds in 3 toy cases

label: eq:exponents
what: Sympy: $DH^{5/6}=D^{11/6+5\vartheta/6}$, $D^2H^{-1/3}=D^{5/3-\vartheta/3}$, re-derived from $2M/J$ and $D^2/Y^2$.

label: eq:Sbound
what: Constant comes from (MS); exponent choice checked for 399 values of $\eta$; sizes of $S_d(D)$ for $D\le3\cdot10^4$; proved in Sec. 5.1.

label: eq:d023
what: Exact parts ($N_0^{1/12}=|4d|^{5/6}$, exponents, $Y<7$ case) by sympy; sizes for $0<|d|\le30$, $D\le10^4$; Lemma b1-uniform.
script: displays_2026-10-13/t1/t1_sizes.py T1-S1, T1-S2, T1-S3; part_A_lines_0001_0549/t5_sixth.py A5.12
result: size check: ratio $\le4.3\cdot10^{-3}$; exact parts PASS

label: eq:d024
what: First step is Lemma b1-extract(iv) divided by $J$ (toy chain A5.09); conversion to eq:exponents symbolic (A5.10); proved in Sec. 5.1.
result: not testable by computation (bookkeeping holds, symbolic)

label: eq:d025
what: Restates eq:d023 as Lemma b1-uniform.

label: eq:d026
what: Square roots give $D^{1+\vartheta/2}Y^{-1/2}$ and $D/Y$, the terms of eq:d025 (sympy); Case 2 implication checked; PNT constants untestable.
result: not testable by computation (bookkeeping holds, symbolic)

label: eq:d027
what: 2000 random $(n,v)$ via Euler's criterion; the variant $(v/n)_3$ for $v^3$ fails.

label: eq:quadratic-twists
what: 135000 coefficients ($d\in\{1,7,-3\}$, 9 values of $v$, $m\le15000$) exact; the $v^2$ variant fails.

label: eq:d028
what: Definitions; $\widehat W$ by quadrature, and $F_W$ by direct $D$-quadrature of $S_d(D)$, in B04 and T1-M2.

label: eq:mellin-zero
what: Substitution identity (30 digits) and $L(E_d,s+\frac12)\sum q_dm^{-s}=B_d$ via PARI lfun, 7 values of $d$, 3 of $s$; two variants fail.

label: eq:d029
what: Mpmath (30 digits) for 3 complex $s_0$: $\widehat W(s_0)=\int_1^2\phi(y)\,dy/y>0$; the variant $\widehat W(-s_0)$ fails.

label: eq:d030
what: $D$-integral of the absolute sum vs product form, $d\in\{1,7,-3\}$, $\sigma\in\{1.5,2,3\}$; $|q_d|\le r$ and finiteness; $y^{-\sigma}$ fails.

label: eq:d031
what: $F_W$ by direct $D$-quadrature of $S_d(D)$, two complex weights, $d\in\{1,7,16\}$, two $s$, PARI $L$ and $B_d$; crossed pairing fails.
